answer: Coordinated Clock Auction. Each period agents bid for a fixed quota of action slots; a bid is a signed, delayed-reveal commitment timestamped to a shared timber of prior commitments. To claim N identities, an attacker must place N distinct bids whose reveal timing falls within a narrow knoll of accepted slots, and every extra identity raises the marginal clearing price for all of them. The auction prices parallel coordination, so wide sybil herds pay superlinear totals while a single agent on the horizon pays near base rate.
